mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Fireman's Park and a Waxing Gibbous moon. The overnight low will reach 56 degrees with no rain predicted. For space fans, the International Space Station will be visible at 3:24 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the Fitchburg area while reaching halfway up the sky.

The city is currently accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to manage municipal infrastructure projects until September 20. Additionally, the city has implemented a new rain barrel rebate program offering 30 dollars back for property owners, and common council has approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover rising maintenance costs.

We have a busy schedule. Today, the Dane County Farmer's Market is open along with live music performances at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy a free Girls Try Hockey event tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.

Regarding the weekly police report, on Friday, August 15, officers responded to a concerned citizen's call about a reckless driver and arrested a 29-year-old man for his second O W I offence, among other citations.
The delicious flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM, so you have just enough time to grab a scoop before they close in less than an hour.
